item.title: Report: Iraq to gradually close border crossings with Iran in coming days
item.description:
Iraq's Prime Minister has ordered the gradual closure of several border crossings with Iran over the coming days, an Iraqi government official told Al Jazeera.
According to the official, the Al-Sheeb border crossing will be closed to passenger traffic and the movement of goods starting Wednesday.

item.title: Iran refuses to surrender enriched uranium, sets conditions for US talks
item.description: Iran's security chief rules out transferring enriched uranium abroad and demands US concessions before talks, as Pakistan seeks to mediate amid rising tensions.

item.title: Report: Witkoff to present Putin with peace proposal following talks with Zelenskyy
item.description: US envoy Steve Witkoff is expected to present Russian President Vladimir Putin with a proposed peace agreement following talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, Axios reported.

item.title: Netanyahu: Iran may use its proxies to disrupt the election
item.description: Speaking to i24NEWS, Netanyahu warns Iran may use proxies to disrupt Israel's election, calls for regime change in Tehran, and criticizes Macron over unrest in France.

item.title: Lebanese report: Hezbollah raises alert level as disagreements emerge in talks With Israel
item.description:
Hezbollah has raised its alert level in recent days amid concerns over a possible escalation with Israel or growing internal tensions in Lebanon, the Lebanese Al-Jadeed television channel reported.
According to the report, the latest round of talks between Israeli and Lebanese military delegations, held Tuesday in Tampa, Florida, has concluded and is expected to resume tomorrow. During the discussions, disagreements emerged over who would have the authority to oversee the implementation of security arrangements in southern Lebanon.
The report also claimed that the Lebanese government reserves the right to oppose any mechanism that would give Israel direct influence over the Lebanese military's movements and decisions in the south of the country.

item.title: 'Ali from Baghdad' turns out to be Israeli named Hezi: The live TV prank in Paris
item.description: Journalist Neria Kraus interviewed a man in Paris who claimed to be an Arab supporter of Israel. Only later did she discover he was Hezi from Kfar Shalem.

item.title: Report: IDF to replace Border Police in Judea and Samaria, freeing officers to combat crime
item.description: Senior officials from the IDF, Israel Security Agency (Shin Bet), and Israel Police met and decided that IDF soldiers would take over some of the duties currently performed by Border Police officers in Judea and Samaria, allowing the officers to focus on combating nationalist crime and riots in the area, Kan 11 News reported.

item.title: Hegseth confirms secret Israel visit, declines to discuss Netanyahu meeting
item.description: US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth confirms an unannounced visit to Israel and meeting with Netanyahu, but declines to reveal what was discussed.

item.title: Trump weighs next move against Iran: The nice way or the not nice way
item.description: President Trump says the US must decide how to secure victory over Iran, declines to provide details on Hegseth's meetings in Israel.

item.title: Major twist in Highway 1 terror plot: Informant admits he lied
item.description: The man whose report led to the arrests on Highway 1 has been located and admitted that he lied. The suspects are apparently not terrorists, but the Shin Bet investigation is ongoing.

item.title: "Sign of life" from Kim Jong Un
item.description: North Korea has released new photographs of Kim Jong Un and his 13-year-old daughter following rumors that the dictator died of a brain hemorrhage.

item.title: Kedumim: 9-year-old spots suspicious object in Samaria, prevents disaster
item.description: A 9-year-old boy from Kedumim spotted a suspicious object near the community and alerted his father. Security forces discovered it was a missile fuel tank left from the war with Iran and safely removed it.
